title: 32 Freezer-Friendly Recipes: Cooking and Storage Reference
scope: Four portions approximately per recipe; approximate cooking durations vary with cut sizes, equipment and actual food temperatures.

standard_guidance.storage_temperature: 0°F (-18°C) or colder; quality targets assume continuously frozen
standard_guidance.cooling: Divide cooked food into shallow portions; refrigerate or freeze within 2 hours (1 hour if ambient temperature exceeds 90°F). Chill promptly before vacuum sealing.
standard_guidance.food_safety: Thaw in refrigerator whenever possible; alternatively use cold water in leakproof bag or microwave with immediate cooking. Check temperatures using a food thermometer. Never reheat leftovers in a slow cooker.
standard_guidance.quality_disclaimer: Best-quality month estimates are conservative planning targets, not safety expiration dates; frozen food continuously kept at 0°F remains safe indefinitely, although quality declines.
